notes.title: Feature Teaser: Map exploration, New Blooms & Demo News
notes.content:
Features in Development


Over 1000 people have grabbed the demo! Plays are on the rise. 



While the Demo is out, it does not yet contain the full spectrum of planned content; I'm hard at work expanding on future areas that provide much more narrative and ways to play.

Map Exploration Tests:


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000437/d40b3fd6aa19da58d5605709e4552fdfc12c3c87.gif"]



Lots of details will emerge in future updates. Early feedback on the potential is very positive.

Exploring substrate (or growing habitat) for mushrooms really does involve stretching out and searching for nutrients, and this plays out excellently in a large bundle of new content....


Seek the bounds of the map

Launch spores for discovery

Reveal opponent networks

Additional Mushroom Avatar gameplay, and more...


New Bloom Artworks:


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000437/9807741b17a9330d1c369219d95b6d47fb0009db.jpg"]



The roster of growable Blooms for EACH Spore is increasing...

While the names and design are not yet revealed, there will be exponential growth in the number of build combinations...go for mass networking, or a balance of defense and propagation. 



Maybe you're just hooked on their unique completion bonuses...





[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000437/eba796aedf9ad920db677b05ac695565755aba64.png"]


Public Demo News:


Thanks for all the wonderful feedback!

Discord, in-game forms and messages are helping reveal improvements and expect continued support & updates for the public content throughout development.



Version 1.0.2 is planned including:


Wind adjustments (for more frequent changes)

Continued bug fixes in tutorial/matches

New Animated Networks

Exhaustion Event issues

Teasing newest Bloom additions (above)



I'm greatly enjoying the process and challenges of building this game, so please stay tuned...the full experience is still to be sampled!

 If you've enjoyed it, share it with someone who likes strategy.

- Jake  (SporeBloom Dev)

notes.title: Demo Update (1.0.1) - Features and Fixes
notes.content:
Have you taken over the maps in the Demo yet? It's best with a friend to outsmart...

Development continues on full game features, but also support for the Demo to continue refining and updated.


New Feature: Guide (v1)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000437/a45bd047231b08b59af06e23986c822315158aab.png"]

This new guide will be expanded upon to address the depth of strategy for new players. I'm dedicated to making onboarding as robust as I can, so expect further guide categories and settings options!


Demo v 1.0.1


ːsteamthisː New Feature: Guide (above) has been added across all menus

ːsteamthisː New Feature: Additional sounds 

ːsteamthisː Offline mode: Supports saved Steam name (ie. on Deck without wifi)

ːsteamthisː Feature Update: Exhausted tiles are more easily restored, and in all shape configurations

ːsteamthisː Feature Update: Colonies preview tool has overhauled visibility and easier deactivation



Adjustments:

Tutorial: Stronger flow to teaching special tiles

Tutorial: UI/General improvements

Map shapes, including number of tiles, and amounts of special tiles improved

Clarification for Advanced Bloom build requirements

Bugs:

Users were able to lock themselves out of expansion in Tutorial

Exhausted event on previous system interfered with goal completion

Several UI bugs (pop-ups)


During release testing, I really enjoyed how broken up this Bisected map became.  It was quiet maze-like, and filled quickly with two CPU's taking over. BubbleFins of all sizes were on display.


You can note the tooltip as I hove the Climate: Hydrated state causing an energy boom.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000437/8316795706ca4fdb2ee4be5356fad9ded6362945.png"]Stay tuned, and as always I'm listening via Discord or in-game Feedback Surveys.  Love the feedback thus far, and keep up that real world fungi interest. There is so much to discover.



- Jake (SporeBloom Creator)

notes.title: Gaining Nutrients: Design Overview
notes.content:
Mushrooms require nutrients to grow, right?  But where do they come from...

MYCELIUM! Check out the cords, the fluff, the sprawling threads.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000437/6a2279f3eabf7241e045e4fa18e791335e75b53d.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000437/b2b4a111042ae230ee495c6a37ed50512f4a66b4.jpg
(foraging photos taken by myself)

The main body of a fungi is actually underground, as demonstrated above. The mycelium network provides access to existing or decomposable materials such as wood, plants, and even other fungi!

In SporeBloom, the conjoining colored patches are your network:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000437/a292c79a4e74dd645598417ec6ab025ff3e05a38.jpg

The basics:


 Tile Nutrients discovered my your mycelium are added to a shared group
 Group Nutrients can be sent anywhere within the network for consumption
 Creating Blooms requires these Nutrients (yum!) as a resource
 Blooms (the 'mushroom' of your fungi species) score you points for victory


Here's an example:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000437/d2115a981aedf2e723129c514c5ecd68c014346f.png

> The Yellow BeanStripe player has a mighty 11 Nutrition, absorbed via expanding their network
> When they expand to the right, 4 Nutrients will be absorbed into the group


This improved Nutrient system affected many other areas:

Based on feedback, this evolved system is undergoing testing, allowing for a more 'digestible' way to track your growth and progress.


 Energy is now tied to the # of moves per turn
 Nitrogen is getting repurposed into a new, to-be-announced feature
 Rebalancing of Blooms' completion bonuses, such as claiming bonus territory or revealing hidden resources
 Network battles, where organisms challenge territory and steal Nutrients!



I hope you've enjoyed a peek at translating the kingdom of fungi into mechanics.

Want more mushroom specific content? Let me know.

---

Join Discord: https://discord.gg/ZNV5q284KH
Support solo development: https://www.patreon.com/c/SporeBloom

Lets inspire young mycologists and expand this genre!

- Jake

While still temporary, things are cultivating nicely; inching closer to the inspiring concept artwork, I'm happy to share some world lore...

Zygo Bank

What is this large structure known as the Zygo Bank? Inspired by real spore structures, this marvel will be core to your many organisms' longevity.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000437/04b9dbb50c8752af53d8014744628b6f609027a9.png

With lots to be unveiled, perhaps your genetic records and discoveries will exist within...but where are those channels flowing?

Character

Who is this interesting character? This mysterious, mycelium inoculating figure?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000437/80e600d37fe7634d3d67dfca6d11c1ab1c81846a.png

Through the interactive scene, you'll not only equip your choice Blooms, but also pop in to style your unlocked cosmetics!


Caps
Staves (Fungus staff)
Bodies!


...mix and match your favorite looks and colors. Most sets are closely tied to the unique Spore aesthetics of the playable SporeBloom world.  Maybe you'll master BeanStripe and collect the whole set?

notes.title: Art Assets Preview (BubbleFins Species)
notes.content:
Curious about the artwork going into the Spores and Blooms (mushrooms)?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000437/24a5c913d3bfd0a98ab1d302978146f12e845e9e.jpg

While most of the current content is a first pass, the key Spores are being analyzed and designed into their final (fingers-crossed) forms!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000437/fd5857bfb8285936ccf7a5dbb4948b47aef18e7b.jpg

Flowing with the games stylized and graphical leaning surfaces, BubbleFins species is getting more emphasis on those sporulating bubbles, new shades, and value structure.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000437/deb331860912dbd50654f903e2602bca38a38071.png
(gameplay view featuring the old, temporary artworks. Look at that completed colony!)

Given the dominant vantage point during a match, these need to be carefully planned to stand out from above. I've been applying my history of concept design and art principles to make them


 Pop out from the map
 Retain unique color, pattern, and shape combinations
 Remain closely in touch with the Spore aesthetic they grow from
 

Stay tuned for other Spores to come and the newest development updates.
